The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 39 epochs. That bill is paid per identity, so 390 aliases cost 125 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
